plans.idea: Classic skyscraper read: headline and subcopy open the column, the bottle anchors the middle, the two badges sit together as one proof row right above a full-width Order Now, and legal closes at the foot.
Product-first: the bottle leads at the top as the visual hook, then the headline and copy, then the CTA immediately after the message, with the badges as a supporting row and legal at the bottom.
Tag-strip top: the FREE DELIVERY / 4 FLAVOURS badge pair works as a kicker band above the headline, the bottle fills the centre, and the CTA plus legal form a grounded footer block.
